onboarding.label: Name for this account
onboarding.privateProfile: Steam accepted the key, but this profile's game details are private. Change it in Steam privacy settings and try again.

steam.name: Steam
steam.title: Connect Steam
steam.intro: Ludarium reads your library with your own Steam Web API key. The key is stored encrypted and never leaves this server.

epic.name: Epic Games
epic.title: Connect Epic Games
epic.intro: Ludarium reads your Epic library the way the Epic Games Launcher does. You sign in on Epic's own page; the sign-in is stored encrypted and never leaves this server.
epic.copyCode: Copy the authorizationCode the page shows, without the quotes, and paste it below. It works once, for a few minutes.

gog.name: GOG
gog.title: Connect GOG
gog.intro: Ludarium reads your GOG library the way GOG Galaxy does. You sign in on GOG's own page; the sign-in is stored encrypted and never leaves this server.
gog.copyCode: GOG then shows a nearly empty page. Copy its whole address from the address bar and paste it below. It works once, for a few minutes.

onboarding.otherAccount: That sign-in was for another {{provider}} account. It is connected as an account of its own; sign in with the one you meant to repair to fix that one.
onboarding.orImport: Or import a list of games from a file

library.enriching: Still updating the library: asking {{step}}. The list refreshes when it is done.
library.alreadyRunning: A sync is already running for this account.

library.partial_other: Synced {{count}} games, but the platform did not hand over all of it.

library.unreadable_other: {{count}} entries it sent could not be read, so nothing was marked as removed.

work.notFound: This game is not in your library.

state.heading: Your game
state.hiddenHint: A hidden game stays in your library and leaves the grid.

work.kept: Kept by you: no sync will remove this copy, even when {{provider}} does not list it.
work.letGoHint: The next sync that does not find it on {{provider}} will move it to removed games.

filters.title: Filters
filters.steamHint_one: A Steam score counts here and in the Steam order only over at least {{count, number}} review. Under it the game stays listed, as unscored.
filters.steamHint_other: A Steam score counts here and in the Steam order only over at least {{count, number}} reviews. Under it the game stays listed, as unscored.
filters.inverted: The first number is above the second, so this range is not applied.

views.title: Saved views
views.none: No saved views yet. Set filters and an order, then name them below.
views.name: Name this view
views.dropped: “{{name}}” opened without what the library no longer has: {{dropped}}.

queue.title: Up next
queue.intro: The games you chose to play next, in your order. Move one up when you want it sooner; take it out when you start playing or change your mind.
queue.empty: Nothing queued yet. Set a game's status to Up next, or use Add to queue on its page.

removed.title: Removed from your accounts
removed.intro: A sync stopped finding these copies on their platform. Nothing was deleted: restoring one brings the game back with its playtime, status and notes, and keeps it in your library even if the platform still does not list it.
removed.empty: Nothing has been removed from your accounts.

manual.intro: For a game no platform reports: a disc, an unredeemed key, an itch.io download. No sync will change or remove it.
manual.notFound: There is no game you added with this link.
manual.title: Title
manual.storeHint: Optional. A store, a platform or a shelf: “PS5 disc”, “itch.io”, “Humble key”.
manual.deleteConfirm: Delete “{{title}}” for good? A game you added does not go to removed games, so it cannot be restored.

demo.banner: This is a demo: a made-up library, and nothing in it can be changed.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.intro: Every account your library comes from. Switching one off stops its syncs; its games stay in your library.
accounts.label: Name
accounts.importedHint: Made by an import, and updated only when you import again.

import.title: Import a file
import.intro: Bring in games kept in a spreadsheet or exported from another tool. The file is read and shown to you first; nothing is added until you confirm. Importing the same file again updates what it added instead of adding it twice.
import.demo: The demo is read-only, so it imports nothing.
import.problems_one: {{count}} row could not be read and will be left out.
import.problems_other: {{count}} rows could not be read and will be left out.
import.sample: The first rows, as they were read

status.connected_one: {{count}} game skipped: {{provider}} syncs your library on its own
status.connected_other: {{count}} games skipped: {{provider}} syncs your library on its own
status.switched_off_one: {{count}} game skipped: this account is switched off
status.switched_off_other: {{count}} games skipped: this account is switched off

import.sweep: Also remove what this file no longer lists
import.sweepHint_one: Moves {{count}} copy to removed games, where it can be restored. Only accounts this file names are touched.
import.sweepHint_other: Moves {{count}} copies to removed games, where they can be restored. Only accounts this file names are touched.
import.sweepUnavailable: Not available while some rows could not be read: they would be removed for being missing.

skipped.connected: skipped, its platform syncs on its own
skipped.switched_off: skipped, the account is switched off

format.title: What the file should look like
format.intro: A CSV with a header row, or a JSON array of objects with the same names. Only title is required; column names are matched regardless of case.
format.encoding: CSV may be UTF-8, UTF-16 or Windows-1250 (what Excel saves on Polish Windows), separated by commas, semicolons or tabs. JSON has to be UTF-8.

columns.title: The game's name. Required.
columns.platform: Where you own it: Steam, EA app, Ubisoft, Battle.net, Xbox, PlayStation, a shelf. Each different name becomes an account of its own.
columns.id: Optional. Your own id for the row; with it, a re-import finds the row even if its title changed.
columns.ownership_type: owned, physical, free, subscription, family_shared or trial. Owned if empty.
columns.item_kind: game, dlc, demo, playtest, soundtrack, video, tool or mod.
columns.acquired_at: When you got it: 2024-05-01, 01.05.2024 or an ISO 8601 time.
columns.release_year: The year the game came out.
